summary: Flux Power Holdings filed an 8-K regarding a committed equity facility with Roth Principal Investments. The company secured a right, but not obligation, to sell up to $40 million of common stock at its sole discretion over a 36-month period. Under the registration rights agreement, up to 38,461,538 shares will be registered for resale by Roth. No fixed price or premium is stated; purchases are market-driven. The facility provides flexible at-the-market capital, not a tender or buyback. Watch for dilution management and the company's capital deployment strategy.
